name: better-agnostr
description: Firefox extension for agnostr.com: JSON viewer, Glub line/flair studio, client spoofing, retro sounds, privacy scrubber, call blocking.

scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist
scripts.lint: eslint --no-config-lookup --parser-options '{"ecmaVersion":2023,"sourceType":"module"}' --global 'window,document,console,setTimeout,clearTimeout,setInterval,clearInterval,crypto,localStorage,Node,NodeFilter,Element,HTMLElement,HTMLInputElement,HTMLTextAreaElement,CustomEvent,MessageEvent,Blob,URL,location,navigator,chrome,browser,fetch,WeakMap,WeakSet,Map,Set,DataView,TextEncoder,TextDecoder,Uint8Array,ArrayBuffer,structuredClone,performance,HTMLCanvasElement,Image,Worker,indexedDB,DOMParser,FileReader,RTCPeerConnection,MediaStream,MediaRecorder,AudioContext,Event,KeyboardEvent,MouseEvent,PointerEvent,MutationObserver,IntersectionObserver,globalThis' --rule '{"no-undef":"error","no-unused-vars":"warn","no-redeclare":"error"}' src/content.js src/page.js src/lib/glub.js src/lib/glub-flair.js src/lib/settings.js src/lib/version.js src/background.js src/popup.js
